journal_description: Generate freee-compatible journal entries from receipt images.
journal_upload_drop_hint: Drag and drop one or more images here, or choose files.
journal_upload_files_empty: No receipts added yet. Pick files from the area above.
journal_upload_run_hint: Once every file has finished uploading, press "Generate journal".
journal_upload_run_disabled_empty: Add at least one receipt to continue.
journal_pending_empty: No pending journal tasks right now.
journal_register_heading: Register in freee / Save to Google Drive
journal_register_hint: Register these entries as freee deals and upload the attached receipt to Google Drive.
journal_complete_hint: Once freee and Google Drive have both finished, click this button to move the session to completed tasks.
registration_follow_up_hint: Reply via the comment box below.
revise_form_hint_journal: The table is read-only. Write the change you want in plain Japanese and the AI will regenerate the entries.
revise_form_placeholder_journal: e.g. Treat the cafe purchase as entertainment expenses
revise_form_heading_followup: Send a follow-up comment to AI
revise_form_hint_followup: Add context for the registration result, or answer the AI's follow-up question.
journal_loading: AI is generating the journal entries...
journal_parse_warning: The AI response could not be parsed as structured data. Showing the raw text below.
tasks_description: Switch between pending and completed journal tasks via the tabs below.
tasks_empty_pending: No pending journal tasks right now.
tasks_pending_resume_hint: Click a card to resume editing the journal in the AI Journal page.
task_card_no_journal: AI response is not yet parsed or is unparseable.
task_detail_delete_confirm: Delete this task? This cannot be undone.
ask_description: Ask general accounting questions. For journal entry creation, use the AI Journal page.
ask_input_placeholder: e.g. How is entertainment expense different from meeting expense?
auth_no_access_lead: Login succeeded, but your account is not a member of the workspace this app is bound to.
auth_no_access_admin_hint: Once the administrator adds you to the workspace, sign in again to start using the app.
